# AddMads — Digital Marketing Agency

> AddMads is a full-service performance-first digital marketing agency based in India, serving clients across India and globally. Founded with the mission to make data-driven marketing accessible to businesses of every size, AddMads combines media buying, SEO, branding, design, and web development under one roof.

AddMads is a performance-first digital marketing agency that helps businesses grow through data-driven advertising, organic search, brand building, and web development. Every service is measured, every rupee is tracked, and every result is reported transparently.

## What Makes AddMads Different

1. **Full-funnel ownership** — Strategy, creative, media buying, SEO, web development, and analytics under one roof. No handoff gaps between teams.
2. **AI-era search readiness** — AddMads builds for GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation), AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), and AIO (AI Input Optimisation) alongside traditional SEO, so clients appear in Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude answers.
3. **Transparent performance** — Every client gets a live Looker Studio dashboard, monthly reports, and full account ownership. No black-box billing.
4. **Measurable results** — Average client ROAS of 3×–6× on Google and Meta Ads; page-1 rankings within 5–8 months for target keywords; websites loading in under 1.5 seconds.

## Services

### Performance Marketing
AddMads designs, launches, and optimises paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, and retargeting platforms.

- **Google Ads & PPC** — Search, display, shopping, and Performance Max campaigns with Target ROAS and Target CPA bidding.
- **Meta / Facebook Ads** — Facebook and Instagram campaigns with Advantage+ Shopping and manual audience targeting.
- **Social Media Marketing** — Organic and paid social strategy across all major platforms.
- **Email Marketing** — Automated sequences, newsletters, and lifecycle campaigns in Klaviyo, Mailchimp, and HubSpot.
- **Content Marketing** — SEO-driven content strategy, blog writing, and thought leadership.
- **Influencer Marketing** — Creator partnerships at nano, micro, and macro level.

Typical outcomes: 3×–6× ROAS within 60–90 days; 30%–50% reduction in CPA over 6 months.

### SEO Services (including AEO and GEO)
AddMads provides comprehensive SEO that covers traditional organic rankings, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) for Google AI Overviews and featured snippets, and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) for AI chatbot visibility.

- **Technical SEO** — Core Web Vitals, crawlability, schema markup, IndexNow, mobile-first optimisation.
- **On-Page SEO** — Keyword strategy, content optimisation, meta tags, internal linking.
- **Off-Page & Link Building** — White-hat editorial backlinks, digital PR, resource link building.
- **Local SEO** — Google Business Profile, local citations, NAP consistency, local schema.
- **E-commerce SEO** — Product page, category page, and site architecture optimisation for WooCommerce and Shopify.
- **AEO** — Structuring content for Google AI Overviews and featured snippets using BLUF framework and FAQ schema.
- **GEO** — Building authoritative, citation-worthy content that appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude answers.
- **YouTube SEO** — Video ranking optimisation for YouTube and Google.

Typical outcomes: Top-10 rankings within 4–6 months; top-3 within 8–12 months; 4×+ organic traffic growth.

### Branding & Visual Identity
Complete brand identity development from strategy to execution.

- **Brand Strategy** — Market positioning, audience personas, competitive analysis, brand architecture.
- **Logo Design** — Primary, secondary, and icon lockups in all formats.
- **Visual Identity** — Colour palette, typography, imagery style, iconography.
- **Brand Guidelines** — Comprehensive brand book for consistent application.
- **Brand Voice & Messaging** — Tone of voice, messaging pillars, copy style guide.
- **Packaging Design** — Product packaging for retail, e-commerce, and food & beverage.

### Graphics & Design
Professional creative services for digital and print.

- **Graphic Design** — All digital and print collateral.
- **UI/UX Design** — Web and mobile interface design, wireframing, prototyping.
- **Motion Graphics** — Animated videos, reels, explainer videos, ad creatives.
- **Print Design** — Business cards, brochures, catalogues, packaging.
- **Social Media Creatives** — Platform-native posts, stories, reels, ad creatives.
- **Presentation Design** — Investor decks, pitch decks, corporate presentations.

### IT Services & Web Development
End-to-end web and application development.

- **WordPress Development** — Custom themes, plugins, WooCommerce stores.
- **Shopify / E-commerce** — Shopify stores, custom themes, Shopify Plus.
- **React & Next.js** — High-performance web applications with SSR/SSG.
- **PHP / Laravel** — Backend development for complex web applications.
- **Webflow / Wix** — No-code and low-code rapid website development.
- **Web Apps & SaaS** — Full-stack SaaS product development from MVP to scale.
- **Landing Pages** — Conversion-optimised landing pages for paid campaigns.
- **AI & Automation** — Chatbots, AI integrations, workflow automation.

### Social Media Management
Complete social media presence management.

- Content creation (graphics, video, copy) for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, YouTube.
- Community management and engagement.
- Monthly content calendars planned and approved in advance.
- Analytics and monthly performance reporting.
- Paid social integration and boosting.
